label: Generative systems
reason: Both act on existing generators. Transferability changes task-specific training; ParaFlow changes numerical sampling with weights fixed.

label: Efficient flow inference
reason: Both address iterative flow inference. ParaFlow parallelizes tentative steps; DRIFT trains residual transport and allocates sequential steps by thickness.

label: Visual representations
reason: Representation choices affect what survives: shared encodings support task transfer; decoupled frequency codes preserve fine detail.

label: Flow matching
reason: ParaFlow solves a pretrained generative trajectory; PDF learns two task-specific fields for disease progression.

label: MRI acquisition priors
reason: DRIFT uses known thickness to condition reconstruction and schedule ODE steps. SPHERE estimates sampling parameters to construct a segmentation prior.

label: Conditional MRI flows
reason: Both use flow learning and structurally meaningful image initialization. DRIFT restores resolution; PDF forecasts future disease and separates morphology from intensity.

label: Haar wavelets · different roles
reason: DeBaT learns low/high latent representations. KernelWave modifies high-frequency coefficients to synthesize smooth/sharp training patches for segmentation.

label: Spatial deformation priors
reason: PDF derives a warp from predicted lesion progression. SPHERE derives a structural proxy from simulated acquisition perturbations. Neither field has the same origin or purpose.

label: Medical segmentation
reason: Both add explicit structural information to segmentation. SPHERE uses an acquisition-related DVF; C2P uses geometry tokens and semantic concepts.

label: Generalization across domains
reason: WCC4MS handles mixed supervision and frequency shifts; C2P addresses multimodal conflicts with geometry/semantic tokens. Annotation and deployment assumptions differ.

label: Acquisition-related robustness
reason: Both tackle image-formation variation. SPHERE recovers MRI sampling parameters; WCC4MS simulates CT-like frequency shifts without estimating true reconstruction kernels.

label: Explicit lesion geometry
reason: PDF needs a baseline lesion mask to forecast evolution; C2P predicts masks and learned geometric attributes. Connecting them into a pipeline would be a new experiment, not a result of either paper.
